s00.note: t=0.00: locate fit the rod lying on the board (ctr [0.577,0.004,0.013], ext 49.2 mm, rms 0.17 mm), and the t=0 sheet frame shows it lying. t=1.64-2.40 (k01-k03): top-down approach over end0 at [0.5637,0.0107]. The k03 wrist view shows the rod lying between the open fingers. Feel-down touched the board at tcp z 0.0179. After the close the width was 4.5 mm, less than the 8 mm rod diameter, so the fingertips met the rod tip or were mostly closed on air. The close force was large: F [-19,37,-54]. Sheet t=5.3/8.0: during the pivot the wrist view shows the rod under the fingers, but the pivot did not keep hold of it. At t=11.48 (k04, after the 6 cm lift) the fingers hang empty above the board, both views show the rod lying on the board, and the tracker puts it at z 0.013, dragged from x 0.599 to 0.555 and rotated. The verifier's 'rod hanging, tilt 79.5deg, bottom z 0.0988' is a bad fit: ext 35 mm and rms 0.56 mm, probably finger pixels mixed into the mask. The rod was not hanging. Re-locate then failed, so the second attempt never ran, and the arm sat idle until the 40 s TIMEOUT. In final.png the rod is still lying on the board near the gray peg plate, empty gripper above.

locate.evidence: The t=0 frames show the rod lying untouched on the board. Fit: n=3384, rms 0.17 mm, ext 49.2 mm (CAD 50), axis horizontal (a_z -0.01), and the fit agrees with the tracker to 0.6 mm.

grasp.evidence: The fingers closed to 4.5 mm (rod is 8 mm), so the hold was only a tip pinch, and the rod was lost during the pivot. At t=11.48 the fingers are empty 19 cm up while the rod lies on the board (tracker z 0.013), moved about 4.4 cm in x and rotated. The verdict FAIL is right, but its reason is not: the 'hanging, tilt 79.5deg, bottom z 0.099' fit is spurious (ext 35 mm, rms 0.56 mm). Re-locate failed, so there was no second attempt.

insert.evidence: Never ran (grasp FAIL). At the end the rod lies on the board, not in the fixture.

s01.note: t=0.00: locate fit the rod lying along -y (ctr [0.378,0.186,0.013], ext 49.8 mm). Its end near y 0.161 sits against a gray upright post, which the obstacle count flagged (end1: 376 points). Attempt 0, t=2.72-3.60 (k01-k03): pinch over end0 at y 0.201. Feel-down never registered the board (contact False, stopped at tcp z 0.0167) and the fingers closed to 3.3 mm, so only the rod tip was pinched. Sheet t=5.3-10.6: the pivot/lift raises the rod, but it hangs tilted next to the fingers rather than vertical; the verifier measured 64 deg. It then fell back to the board and came to rest about 4 cm away, ctr y 0.148, lying past the post. The tracker reads 0.173 for the end keypoint; it reports an end, not the centre, which is why it sits 25 mm from the fit. Attempt 1, t=12.52-13.60 (k04-k06): the target was end0 at y 0.133, and the fingers came down by the gray post. Board contact False at tcp z 0.035: the fingers were stopped by the post, not the board. The close found nothing (width -0.9 mm). t=15.60 (k07): move_to servo_timeout, err 33 mm, wrench [61.9,-9.2,-96.2]. The wrist view shows the fingers jammed against the gray post with the rod lying beside them. So this was a collision with the post, not a reach limit. Width 0.0269 at that point: the fingers were still part-open, not holding the rod. t=26.12 (k09): the arm is up at z 0.21 with an empty gripper, and the rod lies on the board against the post (tracker z 0.013). The verifier's 'tilt 89.8deg, bottom z 0.013, top 56 mm from TCP' correctly describes a lying, ungrasped rod. The arm then idled until the 40 s TIMEOUT. The final frames show the rod still lying by the post.

locate.evidence: The t=0 frames show the rod lying untouched beside the gray post. Fit: n=2747, rms 0.17 mm, ext 49.8 mm, axis horizontal; tracker agrees to 0.4 mm once its end-keypoint offset is allowed for.

grasp.evidence: Attempt 0: a tip pinch (3.3 mm width, board never touched). The rod was lifted but hung about 64 deg off vertical, then dropped and slid about 4 cm to y≈0.148, still beside the post. Attempt 1: the fingers hit the gray post at z 0.035, never reached the rod and closed on nothing (-0.9 mm). On the later move: servo_timeout, wrench Fz -96 N, collision with the post. At t=26.12 the gripper is empty and the rod lies on the board. The FAIL verdict and its reason are both correct.

insert.evidence: Never ran (grasp FAIL). At the end the rod lies on the board next to the post, not in the fixture.
